title: LLM Strategic Reasoning: Agentic Study through Behavioral Game Theory
findings: Assigning religious personas to LLMs can significantly alter their strategic reasoning depth. For instance, a 'Christian' persona increased reasoning depth in the Granite MoE model but decreased it in Gemini 2.0. An 'Atheist' persona also showed divergent effects across models. Furthermore, using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting can introduce or amplify religious biases; for example, the Gemma-2 model showed increased sensitivity to a 'Jewish' attribute, and the InternLM model, initially unbiased, developed religious disparities when CoT was applied.
